confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Negril's resort-town pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer prices are moderately reliable. Accommodation is least certain because Negril rates vary widely by season, beachfront location and property type. The July 2026 window is a peak-season assumption. The FX observation is taken from a search-result snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page (16 October 2026 value), not from an opened page or data file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is general knowledge of Jamaica's west-coast resort towns and other Caribbean beach resort towns with similar tourist pricing, with Jamaican prices adjusted down from the most expensive islands. Drinks were anchored to the local beer price, with cocktail and wine set at roughly two to three times beer.
